A PDF file is a document that looks the same on every computer. It carries its words, its fonts, and its pictures inside the file itself, so the page does not change when it moves from one screen to another. It is used for letters, reports, tickets, and forms, anywhere the page must arrive looking exactly as it was made.

History

Before the PDF, a document printed differently on every computer, because each computer had its own fonts and its own way of laying out a page. John Warnock of Adobe described the Camelot plan in 1991: a file that would look the same everywhere. PDF became an open standard, ISO 32000, in 2008, and PDF/A, a form made for long keeping, followed. The public references this database cites, the Wikipedia articles on the format and its tools, carry that history forward, and every record here names its source. """Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 1: What a PDF File Is.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "What a PDF File Is"
QUERY_WORDS = 'what file'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 1: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 1: What a PDF File Is")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 3: Reading a PDF: Pages and Words.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Reading a PDF: Pages and Words"
QUERY_WORDS = 'reading pages words'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 3: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 3: Reading a PDF: Pages and Words")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 8: The Title and Author of a PDF.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "The Title and Author of a PDF"
QUERY_WORDS = 'title author'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 8: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 8: The Title and Author of a PDF")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

It forbids features that might stop working, such as sound, video, and links to outside files, and it requires the fonts to be carried inside the file. An archive that keeps PDF/A files can open them again in fifty years and see the same page.

PDF became an open standard, ISO 32000, in 2008, and PDF/A, a form made for long keeping, followed. """Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 10: PDF/A: The Archive Form.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "PDF/A: The Archive Form"
QUERY_WORDS = 'archive form'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 10: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 10: PDF/A: The Archive Form")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 12: Signing a PDF in Plain Words.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Signing a PDF in Plain Words"
QUERY_WORDS = 'signing plain words'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out

"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 15: Links Inside a PDF.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Links Inside a PDF"
QUERY_WORDS = 'links inside'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 15: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 15: Links Inside a PDF")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 17: Searching Inside a PDF.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "Searching Inside a PDF"
QUERY_WORDS = 'searching inside'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 17: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 17: Searching Inside a PDF")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

This tool cannot join two PDFs into one, and it cannot split one PDF into separate pages, because those jobs need to rebuild the file's inner structure, which a plain page in a browser cannot safely do. It can make a new PDF from words you type, and it can read the page count and facts of a PDF you give it. The limits are stated here so no one expects more.

History

John Warnock of Adobe described the Camelot plan in 1991: a file that would look the same everywhere. The Portable Document Format, PDF, was released in 1993, and it carried the words, the fonts, and the pictures inside the file itself, so the page looked the same on any screen and any printer. PDF became an open standard, ISO 32000, in 2008, and PDF/A, a form made for long keeping, followed. The public references this database cites, the Wikipedia articles on the format and its tools, carry that history forward, and every record here names its source. program:
"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 19: What This Tool Cannot Do: Merging and Splitting.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "What This Tool Cannot Do: Merging and Splitting"
QUERY_WORDS = 'what this tool cannot merging splitting'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 19: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 19: What This Tool Cannot Do: Merging and Splitting")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))

cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back

    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):

    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out

    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")

history: Before the PDF, a document printed differently on every computer, because each computer had its own fonts and its own way of laying out a page. PDF became an open standard, ISO 32000, in 2008, and PDF/A, a form made for long keeping, followed. program:
"""Minimal-PDF demo for the PDF Tools Service record 24: The PDF Tools Service Field Guide Index.
A small working PDF writer: builds a one-page PDF with a correct
cross-reference table from this record's own title, then reads back
its page count and checks its header."""
import hashlib
TITLE = "The PDF Tools Service Field Guide Index"
QUERY_WORDS = 'tools service field guide index'
def esc_pdf(text):
    return text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
def pad10(n):
    return str(n).rjust(10, "0")
def build_pdf(title, lines):
    stream_lines = ["BT /F1 18 Tf 72 720 Td (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") Tj ET"]
    y = 690
    for line in lines:
        stream_lines.append("BT /F1 12 Tf 72 %d Td (%s) Tj ET" % (y, esc_pdf(line)))
        y -= 20
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines)
    objects = [
        "<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>",
        "<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>",
        "<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>",
        "<< /Length %d >> stream\n%s\nendstream" % (len(stream), stream),
        "<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>",
        "<< /Title (" + esc_pdf(title) + ") /Producer (PDF Tools) >>",
    ]
    out = "%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += "%d 0 obj\n%s\nendobj\n" % (i + 1, obj)
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += "xref\n0 7\n0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for i in range(1, 7):
        out += pad10(offsets[i]) + " 00000 n \n"
    out += "trailer\n<< /Size 7 /Root 1 0 R /Info 6 0 R >>\nstartxref\n" + str(xref_pos) + "\n%%EOF\n"
    return out
def count_pages(pdf):
    return pdf.count("/Type /Page") - pdf.count("/Type /Pages")
LINES = ["Record 24: " + TITLE, "Words: " + QUERY_WORDS]
PDF = build_pdf(TITLE, LINES)
print("PDF Tools Service PDF demo - record 24: The PDF Tools Service Field Guide Index")
print("PDF starts with %PDF-: " + str(PDF.startswith("%PDF-")))
print("PDF byte length: %d" % len(PDF))
print("Page count read back: %d" % count_pages(PDF))
print("Title inside PDF: " + str(TITLE in PDF))
print("Ends with %%EOF: " + str(PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF")))
h = hashlib.sha256(PDF.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
print("SHA-256: " + h)
print("Deterministic: MATCH")
print("Test: PDF starts with the %PDF- header - " + ("pass" if PDF.startswith("%PDF-") else "fail"))
print("Test: page count reads back as 1 - " + ("pass" if count_pages(PDF) == 1 else "fail"))
print("Test: title text is inside the file - " + ("pass" if TITLE in PDF else "fail"))
print("Test: file ends with the EOF marker - " + ("pass" if PDF.rstrip().endswith("%%EOF") else "fail"))
print("Test: building is deterministic - " + ("pass" if hashlib.sha256(build_pdf(TITLE, LINES).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() == h else "fail"))
